cell: logical 1x1x1 on 0.55 m grid; mount = Socket_Mount_Bottom

R4W_BeamCutter_ROOT.style: R41_Turret_v6.1 standard (heavy industrial armour + team colour)

Socket_Mount_Bottom.role: mounting face centre, normal -Y, connects to cell (0,-1,0)

R4W_BeamCutter_Yaw.role: Yaw: rotate around local Y only

R4W_BeamCutter_Pitch.role: Pitch: rotate around local X only

R4W_BeamCutter_FocusRing.role: focus ring: rotates about local Z (fire axis) during warm-up / fire

R4W_BeamCutter_FinL.role: radiator fin bank: rotates about local Z (upper hinge), opens 35 deg on Heat/Cooldown

R4W_BeamCutter_FinR.role: radiator fin bank: rotates about local Z (upper hinge), opens 35 deg on Heat/Cooldown

Beam_Core.role: beam core FX (0.70 m visual stub; game range 16 m drawn by runtime) - idle scale 0.001

Beam_Sheath.role: beam sheath FX near the lens - idle scale 0.001

Beam_EmitterGlow.role: emitter warm-up glow FX - idle scale 0.001

Beam_HeatGlow.role: housing heat glow FX - shown in Heat

notes: Focus ring end angle in Cooldown is 180 deg (6-fold symmetric: identical to rest).
